matches_set.description: Huel Complete Protein is the world’s first nutritionally complete, plant-based protein powder. We know what you’re thinking: isn’t the big issue with plant protein powders that they’re not well-rounded? Well, not many are…but this one is. Made from sustainably sourced, high-quality, animal-free ingredients, they’re able to create a blend of hemp, faba and pea protein that make this a complete protein. There’s more to this protein powder than just protein – you also get essential fats, fiber, and all 27 essential vitamins & minerals . You can lean on this as a staple to your daily routine. It’s naturally gluten-free and contains 9g of essential amino acids ( EAAs ) and 5g of branched-chain amino acids ( BCAAs ) .
